zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.1.0-beta.4** 是第四版预发布，走 beta 更新通道；正式版仍为 **0.0.18**。
B4-01 至 B4-08 已合入：并行与隔离、项目目标、自主档位、恢复与记忆维护。

zh.title: 新增
items: 一个项目最多同时执行三个任务，整机回合并发默认四个、可设为一至八个；优先级、前置依赖和全局回合排队在宿主执行。
独立写任务使用 Git worktree。验证与签收后可选择「合回改动」；发生冲突会等待你的决定。
可以取代、暂停和恢复任务。取代会保留原任务的恢复上下文，恢复后重新核验。
项目目标支持定时、文件、Git 与任务事件观察。探测只读，经过本地授权与真实证据；观察未变化时不唤醒机器人。「CI 挂了才告诉我」会保存为失败时通知。
目标可选「只报告」「先提议」「自行推进」。自行推进每天最多开三个低优先级任务；重复事实不重复开任务。达到预算或连续失败时退回提议卡。目标任务默认需要确认签收，可由用户明确开启自动签收。
重启按依赖顺序恢复宿主状态；连续回合失败会暂停自动推进。记忆会处理过期、冲突及文件来源变化，固定记忆保留。

zh.title: 变化
items: 机器人头像支持不同外形、颜色、图片与状态动画。档案、目标、任务和记忆使用统一的自定义控件与 SVG 图标。
对话及时刷新宿主生成的决策与合回卡片；相同任务事实不再反复汇报，证据可展开查看。
构建按工作区顺序执行，避免两个应用同时清理共用产物。

zh.title: 已知限制
items: 机器人自身保持只读；写入由任务执行。外部副作用仍需单独授权。
隔离写任务需要 Git、足够磁盘空间。非 Git 项目不会自动退回共享目录写入。合回不会替你推送远端。
目标的 token 硬限尚未实现，该配置会被拒绝。探测次数与自动任务数有宿主预算。
模型可能填错目标参数或在文字中描述错签收状态；宿主会拒绝无效参数，实际状态与签收以结构化卡片和证据为准。
TUI 与远程机器人入口留到 Beta5。CLI 的项目代理入口尚未开放。
本版不会把自动化测试写成跨平台交互安装验收，也不声称已经完成负责人连续日用五天。

zh.title: 降级说明
items: 可切回经典界面，或重新安装 beta.3 / 0.0.18；旧版本忽略新增目标与机器人运行态。
降级前退出新版本；降级期间持续目标不再推进。升级回来后，档案、原会话、记忆和目标保留。
独立 worktree 和设备预算 / 游标属于本机状态，导出项目不会迁移这些内容。失败 worktree 暂存七天，不会立即删除。

en.title: Notes
items: **Peer Agent 0.1.0-beta.4** is the fourth prerelease on the beta update channel. Stable remains **0.0.18**.
B4-01 through B4-08 deliver concurrency, isolation, objectives, autonomy, recovery, and memory maintenance.

en.title: Added
items: Up to three tasks per project, with four concurrent device turns by default (configurable from one to eight), with host enforced priorities, dependencies, and turn queues.
Independent writing tasks use Git worktrees. After verification and acceptance, choose “Merge changes back.” Conflicts wait for your decision.
Supersede, pause, and resume tasks. Superseded work retains recovery context and is verified again after resuming.

Objectives support schedules, file, Git, and task event observations. Probes are read only and return local authorization and real evidence. Unchanged observations do not wake the bot; failure only CI monitoring is supported.

Objectives can report, propose, or act. Acting starts at most three low priority tasks per day and never repeats a task for the same facts. Budgets and repeated failures fall back to proposals. Objective tasks require acceptance by default; users can explicitly enable automatic acceptance.
Host state recovers in dependency order. Repeated turn failures pause automatic work. Memory maintenance handles expiry, conflicts, and changed file sources while preserving pinned memories.

en.title: Changed
items: Bot avatars support different shapes, colors, uploaded images, and animated states. Profile, objective, task, and memory controls share custom controls and SVG icons.
Conversations refresh host decision and merge cards promptly. Unchanged task reports are deduplicated; evidence can be expanded.
Workspace builds run in order to avoid concurrent cleanup of shared outputs.

en.title: Known limits
items: The project bot remains read only. Tasks perform writes; external side effects still require separate authorization.
Isolated writing needs Git and available disk space. Non-Git projects do not silently fall back to shared directory writes. Merging does not push to a remote.
A token hard limit is not implemented and is rejected. Probe and automatic task counts have host enforced budgets.
Models can submit invalid objective parameters or misstate acceptance in prose. The host rejects invalid inputs; structured cards and evidence determine actual status.
TUI and remote bot surfaces remain for Beta5. CLI project bots are not exposed yet.
Automated tests are not presented as interactive installation checks on every platform or five days of owner daily use.

en.title: Downgrade
items: Switch to the classic interface or reinstall beta.3 / 0.0.18. Older versions ignore added objective and bot runtime state.
Quit the newer app before downgrading. Objectives stop while using an older version; profiles, conversations, memories, and objectives remain when upgrading again.
Worktrees, device budgets, and cursors stay local and are not included in project export. Failed worktrees are retained for seven days.
